components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for main calls to action across the lawyer and admin portal.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #EF950A; color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 16px; transition: all 0.4s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d18105; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(239, 149, 10, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: Mohamy Smart is a premium legal-tech application tailored for legal professionals and administrators in the Gulf/MENA region. It rejects the generic SaaS and sterile corporate enterprise aesthetics, drawing inspiration instead from the visual weight, precision, and elegance of high-end editorial layouts and elite legal institutions.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained Palette: Sophisticated warm tones with Amber-Orange accents.

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary Orange accent is used on ≤10% of any given screen.

rules.name: No Pure Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#ffffff) as backgrounds or text.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: The Tajawal font family is the sole typeface allowed.

dos: Do design in RTL native layout first.
Do use Tajawal exclusively across all applications.
Do limit the use of the Orange brand color to focal points.
donts: Don't use pure black #000000 for dialog backdrops.
Don't use side-tab accent borders (thick vertical lines on one side of cards).
Don't animate CSS layout properties like width, height, padding, or margin.
